summary: OccHealthEditAll is part of the HSPnet application, used for managing occupational health data in an educational setting. It involves data entry and update functionalities for student immunization and health requirements.
purpose: The purpose of OccHealthEditAll is to provide a user interface for managing student occupational health data, including immunization records and other health-related requirements.

workflows.name: Data Entry
steps: User interacts with gridDataEdit for data entry.
Data is validated using JavaScript for dirty fields.
Submissions are handled through commands like cmdSaveAll and cmdSaveEditNext.

business_rules: If EnrollmentID is 0, hide certain buttons in the header.
If gridDataEdit contains fewer than 14 rows, hide buttons to prevent scrolling.
validations: Ensure textarea input does not exceed 1000 characters using onKeyUp event.
conditions: Check if a UserSession exists before proceeding with data operations.
system_behavior: Page scripts and JavaScript variables are dynamically registered depending on postbacks.
Validation and processing of health data occurs upon command execution.
dependencies: UserSession for maintaining user-specific session information.
exceptions: Cancel data operations if UserSession is null.
